title: Rocket
blurb: Four fins only separate in the top view, so all three photos are needed.

title: House with chimney
blurb: The chimney lands exactly where it is in the front, side and top pictures.

title: Vase
blurb: A round object needs one photo: it is spun into a solid (One view: Round).

title: Head and shoulders (pencil)
blurb: Pencil drawings that run off the picture: the whole figure is still filled in.

title: Airplane
blurb: Swept wings and a tail fin: the top picture gives the wing shape, front and side give the thickness.

title: Castle
blurb: Four corner towers and a central keep land exactly where the three views cross.

title: Robot
blurb: A boxy figure: head, arms, legs and feet each take their size from a different view.

title: Toy car
blurb: The side picture makes the wheels round and the roof slope; front and top give the width.

title: Chess pawn
blurb: One picture of a round piece, spun into a solid (One view: Round).
